description: Cross-linked evidence required before one licensed macro-release window may enter the empirical campaign ledger.

capture_link_rules.pre_snapshot: The pre_snapshot_captured event must reference exactly one immutable HTTPS snapshot received before scheduled_at.
capture_link_rules.release_components: Every release_component must reference an immutable websocket receipt containing the named provider component.
capture_link_rules.receive_clock: Trace observed_at and capture received_at must agree within the registered tolerance.
capture_link_rules.payload_identity: Every capture_id, payload hash, byte length and normalized provider event identity must replay from the raw store.
capture_link_rules.store_claim: The trace store_audit values must equal a fresh integrity report; passed:true alone is not evidence.

enrollment_rules.rights: A non-placeholder approved attestation must grant retention, historical backtesting, machine learning and derived-data rights.
enrollment_rules.license: Every linked observation must use the attested non-synthetic license class.
enrollment_rules.provenance: The trace must be licensed_shadow and captures must be authenticated API or calendar-stream receipts.
enrollment_rules.schedule: Synthetic or example schedule sources never enroll.
enrollment_rules.completeness: Both the Phase 4 window audit and the Phase 5 cross-link audit must pass.

ledger_rules.append_only: Enrollment records are append-only JSONL with content hashes.
ledger_rules.duplicates: Duplicate package, run, plan or release-window identities fail closed.
ledger_rules.promotion: Only hash-valid enrollable records count toward the registered CPI and NFP floors.
ledger_rules.economic_claim: Campaign promotion remains operational evidence and never establishes predictive edge.
